purpose: Verify database-fault recovery and graceful shutdown in the actual packed server factory, not a source-only runtime.

method.factorySource: Direct import of the extracted tarball module used by the CLI; no server source factory substitution.
method.database: New generated loopback PostgreSQL fixture, migrated and seeded by createLaunchDatabase; never the existing development database.
method.fault: Dedicated TCP proxy destroys only this fixture runtime's database connections for 12 seconds.
method.authentication: Required authentication with fixture App ID and production operational admission authority; no injected auth or admission service.
method.traffic: One live room/controller emitting inputs every 50ms; second host bootstrapped before the fault probes new room admission.
method.shutdown: Disconnect owned clients, await runtime.drain(), then await runtime.stop(); no forced process exit on the passing run.

faultTimeRoomAdmission.message: Room capacity is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

expectedFaultLogs: App ID lastUsedAt update failed with ECONNRESET during interruption.
Runtime usage persistence and its operational-event enqueue failed during interruption.
Room admission and admission heartbeat reported ECONNRESET during interruption.

priorArtifactComparison.behavior: Recovery and uninterrupted input passed, but runtime.stop() exceeded 10 seconds even after a completed drain.
priorArtifactComparison.resolution: The final patch additionally clears settled query/results when the socket closes and settles an existing pool end; the new packed artifact stops in 9ms.

limitations: External dependencies were linked from existing installed workspace dependencies; this is not independent clean-registry installation certification.
This is a low-volume packaging/recovery check, not the release-load soak or production infrastructure proof.
Full release candidate and registry installation verification remain in the existing G7 publication path.
Temporary tarball and diagnostic paths are local artifacts; this retained JSON preserves their measured results and content hashes.
